title: Controlled Unity dense-fog fallback demonstration
interpretation: The simple image-box warning baseline did not trigger before collision. Fusion had no visual confirmation at intervention and used the existing Raycast fallback. Both had live model inference enabled. Raycasts are unaffected by visual fog or camera far clipping in Unity.
limitations: One controlled pair; not a fog detection accuracy benchmark or general safety evaluation.
The scene and known route are shared. Synthetic fog and a camera far clip of 8 m model restricted visibility; physical sensor degradation is not simulated.
No claim that the camera sees through fog, or that a physical radar has been tested in fog.
RunResult.scenario inherits CarCutIn from the scenario initializer; the capture helper disables hazard motion and parks the car before simulation advances.
Fixed capture framerate: not a real-time latency measurement.

cases.name: 18-fog-vision-only
cases.weather: Unity ExponentialSquared fog; physics rays are unaffected. Not a physical radar-weather test.
cases.timing: Fixed 30 fps simulation capture for presentation. Paired fixed 22-second recordings. The simple vision-only baseline uses image boxes; both controllers share route following. No metric distance enters the vision-only warning decision.
cases.overlayProvenance: Model-view RGB held from the exact inference input; JSON boxes are native Unity model outputs for that same input. No ground-truth boxes.
